_readme: Hand-kept. Merchant's Favor from Waylaid Crates of Textiles: a crate (world drop or Auction House) is filled with ONE bundle of its row and handed in for Favor. Ids: crates and fills from the client's item table; ranks, fills and Favor from the source. Used with Auctionator prices (data/prices.json) to say what a Favor recipe costs in gold.
_firstBonus: The first crate you hand in comes with a one-time quest worth this much Favor on top of the crate's (told by the site owner, who played it).
